children.text: The music opens with a duduk melody and a synthesizer underneath it. The video pans across a field situated between mountains.
The video toggles between multiple scenes within nature - particularly mountain ranges, plateaus, rivers, and arid fields.

Sehid Hozan Serhad died in 1999 and was involved with the PKK at the end of his life. The video of him playing saz is likely of him performing in Turkish. Link to video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8-aWZY-LZpk&list=PLmE1rFuNApNSdh0RI4aBst5kUVramGNKG&index=46
